column1: # The link-profile bench's floors (tests/e2e.rs, bench_link_profiles), as
# CI's speed regression job enforces them (.github/workflows/speed.yml):
# profile, least Mbit/s, most per cent of the file sent again.
# About a third of the least seen, on CI's runners and here (release
# builds): clean 316 to 648 Mbit/s, 0.1 % loss 125 to 131, 1 % 198 to 303,
# 5 % 120 to 158, capped at 100 Mbit/s 65 to 75, over TCP with UDP blocked
# random loss taken for a policer, pacing gone — not a few per cent, which
# a shared runner varies by more. A transfer of a second or two is mostly
# its start, and what the slow start sends beyond the test proxy's buffers
# is sent again: up to 11 per cent clean, 18 at 1 and at 5 per cent loss.
